messages:
Maya: Pushed a new Figma frame for audit log navigation: https://figma.com/file/abc. Quick poll: breadcrumb (Org > Team > Audit) or horizontal tabs (Events | Filters | Snapshots)? Which gives faster discovery for RBAC-linked flows?
Sam: Tabs for quick switching, breadcrumbs for context when linking from a role/permission. If we expect deep links from RBAC pages, breadcrumbs help.
Ali: Implementation note: breadcrumbs tie nicely to existing router; tabs would be query param or nested route. Tabs easier to keep state when switching views without full route hops.
Jordan: A11y: tabs must implement role=tablist and arrow-key nav; breadcrumbs need skip links. Tabs better for keyboard users to move between related panels.
Maya: Use-case data: support teams will jump from a specific permission to the audit entries for that permission. That's a deep link pattern. Breadcrumbs make back nav explicit.
Sam: What about hybrid? Show breadcrumb with last segment replaced by tabs. Eg Org > Team > [Audit: Events | Filters | Snapshots]. Might be verbose.
Ali: Hybrid is doable but complexity for responsive/mobile might spike. Need truncation rules and a collapse for narrow widths.
Jordan: Microcopy: label the tabs as nouns not verbs: 'Events', 'Filters', 'Snapshots'. For breadcrumb when linking from RBAC use full role name instead of generic 'Team'.
Maya: Mobile: collapse tabs into a segmented select. Breadcrumb becomes a single line with back chevron. Keep export action inside Snapshots view.
Sam: UX nit: make tabs sticky under the header so filter toolbar stays in view. Also ensure focus styles are 3:1 contrast at minimum.
Ali: Logged ENG ticket ENG-4301: implement tabbed audit with sticky header + keyboard nav. I'll attach layout constraints for virtualization and z-indexs.
Jordan: I'll draft a11y test cases: screen reader walkthroughs, keyboard only flows, zoom + truncated names behavior.
Maya: Action: I'll iterate Figma with hybrid layout and mobile variants, then share. Also add tooltip copy for 'Snapshots' explaining exports.
deploy-bot: Figma link updated by Maya at 1747012400.
Maya: Thanks all, closing for now — will reopen if mobile prototype needs more debate :)
